tarjetas.detalle: Owns the brand and business model
A share of the franchisee's sales

turnos.t: How can a brand open shops everywhere without paying for them?
Franchising. The franchisor lets franchisees use its brand, products and business model. In return, each franchisee pays an initial fee, plus royalties: a share of its sales.

The franchisor grows fast with other people's capital. The franchisee gets a proven model, with training and supplies, but must follow strict rules. The big risk: one poor franchisee can damage the whole brand's reputation.
